thread:
viv: Quick design review of the desktop console in dark mode. Two pain points: sidebar links feel washed against the main surface, and code block tokens look too bright compared to adjacent charts. dropping a compact vars proposal and a couple of copy ideas.

harper: can you paste the vars so i can try them in storybook?

viv: sure, short set: ```/* surfaces */ --bg: #0c0f12; --panel: #111316; --sidebar: #0f1214; --muted: #9aa2a8; /* accents */ --brand: #66c8ff; --success: #7de3b8; --warn: #ffd67a; /* charts */ --spark: rgba(102,200,255,0.82); --heat-low: #46b7aa; --heat-med: #ffd77a; --heat-high: #ff7a66; /* code */ --code-fg: #dff7ff; --code-bg: #0d1316; */```

eli: sparkline alpha helps. two quick notes: 1) sidebar link contrast is failing at small sizes when adjacent to muted labels, 2) code-fg at #dff7ff creates a visual halo that competes with charts.

priya: accessibility note: small sidebar labels and inline percentage chips need 4.5:1 against --sidebar. Also ensure focus states for collapsed nav are 3:1 visible.

harper: for the code vs chart issue, maybe reduce code token highlight saturation and add a 1px inner shadow on panels to separate zones. Also make active chart series use --brand as a 1.5px stroke rather than a bright fill. That should lower the perceived brightness of code blocks.

viv: updated suggestions: drop --code-fg to #bfeff9, add `--panel-sep: rgba(255,255,255,0.03)`, reduce chart fill alpha to 0.7 when "Unified contrast" toggle is on, and give sidebar active links a slightly stronger delta: `--sidebar-active: #89d9ff`. also propose a settings copy change.

eli: copy: don't use "Color-blind mode". propose "Accessibility: Heatmap patterns" or "Heatmap patterns (accessibility)" for the toggle. for the unified contrast toggle, suggest: "Balanced contrast" with tooltip: "Adjusts colors for clearer hierarchy between UI regions, charts, and code."

priya: +1 on copy. add a short tooltip for sidebar: "Use larger text in compact mode to meet contrast requirements." and include this in the a11y checklist.

harper: layout nit: token legend inside charts is long. collapse into an inline popover that opens on click/focus. keyboard users must be able to open with Enter and Tab to the items. add visible focus ring (3:1).

design-bot: Figma frame added: https://figma.com/file/qwerty-console-dark-unify (viv/desktop-unify-pass)

viv: plan of record:
- adjust --code-fg to #bfeff9 and add --panel-sep for subtle separation
- reduce chart fill alpha in "Balanced contrast" mode and use --brand for active stroke
- bump sidebar active link color to --sidebar-active and re-run contrast checks for small labels
- add heatmap pattern toggle labeled "Heatmap patterns (accessibility)" with tooltip: "Improves contrast for color-vision differences."
- move legend into keyboard-friendly popover in compact/desktop responsive breakpoints

viv: i'll open a small PR with CSS variables + Storybook fixtures and attach the automated contrast report. pinging @priya for the a11y checklist once PR is up. thanks :raised_hands:
